sup:70510.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €370.96 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, no Preisgleitklausel. 

Regarding our cost structure, CU-NOTATION rose 47.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. Additionally, PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 14 % of our cost.

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG

move.subject: Re: Quote from Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG: Nordmark passes on copper for the 7.5 kW motor
move.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your offer and for explaining your position.

Our data shows a different picture on some points:
Our demand forecast for this part has risen 11.9% (fc:350011@2026-09).
Our last 3 orders for this part were at EUR 348.32 per unit (po:4500014474-10, po:4500014413-10, po:4500014350-20).
We would also welcome your view on the points from our meeting about "Annual review" (doc:20260410-70510-M1).

Please find our proposal below.

We look forward to your reply.

Kind regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

move.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the price history data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. 

Our current Angebot is a price of €373.82 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, no Preisgleitklausel. 

To offer you the most competitive rate, we must maintain our standard 30-day payment terms, as extending to 90 days would require a price increase. Consequently, we can propose a revised price of €369.70 per unit. Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 30 days net: €369.70 per unit, which reflects a price of €369.70 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, no Preisgleitklausel at standard terms. 

A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Which volume can you commit to? We are happy to discuss this in a call; until then our offer stands for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG
